evidence_layers.definition: Identity, envelope, signature, order, declared shape, and contribution membership established without decoding the affected value.
Exact occurrence, bytes, presence, or count established from the admitted source.
A typed value or typed null produced under an accepted field and shape contract.
A decoded reference, provider, localization, or dependency connected to its authoritative target or established as unresolved.
does_not_prove: semantic taxonomy beyond the resolved evidence

evidence_layers.definition: Applicability, meaning, classification, consequence, or interpretation authorized by preceding evidence and accepted policy.

state_classes.definition: The member, record, subject, or population member is outside the observed admitted evidence; absence is not inferred unless exhaustive authority separately establishes it.
Structure or occurrence is independently known but the accepted bounded shape cannot produce the typed value.
The accepted decoder establishes the semantic null state; this is an explicit typed-null fact where the constructor publishes null.
A reference target FormKey is decoded but no authoritative target record resolves.
Every prerequisite needed by the fact constructor is established, including target/provider resolution where applicable.
Accepted semantic prerequisites establish that the fact or population applies.
The input is well framed but the bounded contract lacks the named family, field, shape, localization, archive, discovery, or applicability capability.
Accepted semantics establish that the fact or coverage member does not apply; this is not unsupported and produces no applicability gap.
The lower-level evidence cannot be separated safely or an atomic publication invariant is violated, so no authoritative snapshot publication is admitted.

normalization_rules.subject: canonical FormKey
normalization_rules.rule: Use exactly eight lowercase hexadecimal local-ID digits, colon, and a lowercase plugin filename with a nonempty basename and esm, esp, or esl extension; translate through TES4 masters before formatting; extension alone never establishes light origin.

normalization_rules.subject: fact-ID segment
normalization_rules.rule: Normalize the semantic value first, then percent-encode its UTF-8 bytes under RFC 3986 with uppercase hex, space as %20, and only ALPHA, DIGIT, hyphen, period, underscore, and tilde unescaped.

normalization_rules.subject: sequence and set ordering
normalization_rules.rule: Preserve manifest plugins, TES4 masters, override contributions, provider chains, and link occurrence order; format zero-based ordinals with minimum width four; sort maps and semantic sets ordinally by canonical identity; sort final facts ordinally by complete fact_id.

normalization_rules.subject: casing
normalization_rules.rule: Lowercase plugin filenames, provider IDs, paths, semantic contribution identity components, signatures embedded in identities, and projected gap signature/field components; retain Bethesda record and subrecord signature fact values as uppercase ASCII.

normalization_rules.subject: typed primitive
normalization_rules.rule: Integer is exact signed Int64, number is finite IEEE-754 with numeric equality including negative zero equal to zero, and string, boolean, and null require matching JSON kinds; arrays and objects are never fact values.

normalization_rules.subject: semantic contribution identity
normalization_rules.rule: Construct source={lower plugin}|order={D4}|record={canonical FormKey}|signature={lower signature}|flags={lower hex minimum width 8}|deleted={lower boolean}|compressed={lower boolean}.

normalization_rules.subject: link identity and state
normalization_rules.rule: Use field_lower:component_lower_or_value:ordinal_D4 as identity; only null, resolved, and unresolved states publish; only XLKR may use linked-reference or keyword components.

normalization_rules.subject: FaceGen path
normalization_rules.rule: Replace backslash with slash and lowercase invariantly before comparison, subject construction, and fact-ID escaping.

normalization_rules.subject: taxonomy identity
normalization_rules.rule: Identity is canonical subject, subject type, axis, facet, code-or-literal-null, applicability, and role; assigned requires non-null code and every other applicability requires typed-null code.

normalization_rules.subject: gap aggregation
normalization_rules.rule: Aggregate exact positive affected-member counts by the unique ordinal key population plus missing_capability; generated IDs and reason prose never enter projected facts.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: A snapshot accompanies invalid_input, changed_during_read, or failed, or either required result boolean is absent.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: Only the two result facts and independently established result_gaps survive when no snapshot is published.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: Master is missing, master index or light/full origin is untranslatable or ambiguous, local ID is out of range, or the canonical lexical form is invalid.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: Malformed bytes prevent authoritative record framing, contribution membership, signature, order, or flags.

atomic_boundaries.result_effect: Terminal no-snapshot state rather than an unsupported semantic member.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: State, field, component, ordinal, or target combination is invalid, or the target master index is untranslatable.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: A decoded null singleton is separable and publishes only typed-null /state; an unresolved translatable target is not rejected.
atomic_boundaries.result_effect: Invalid link construction is rejected; unsupported later semantics do not erase valid lower record facts.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: Only part of the six finite position/rotation values is published or any value is nonfinite.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: A completely absent placement is valid and emits no placement facts.
atomic_boundaries.result_effect: Reject the invalid reference fact object; do not repair the vector.

atomic_boundaries.scope: one FaceGen mesh or tint asset object
atomic_boundaries.reject_when: present/exact_absence_known is true/true, present lacks a declared-chain winner, non-present has a winner, or the winner is outside the declared chain.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: Valid applicability and the other asset object remain conceptually separable, but the published candidate/oracle object is rejected at its owning contract boundary.
atomic_boundaries.result_effect: Invalid publication rather than a fourth availability state.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: A row is missing, extra, duplicated, arithmetically impossible, uses an unknown state, marks 0/0 other than completed, or marks a gap-bearing/incomplete row completed.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: Underlying facts do not authorize publication of an inconsistent coverage registry.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: Population/capability is outside the closed vocabulary, affected count is nonpositive, or an aggregate key is duplicated.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: Valid lower-layer facts remain independently true but the inconsistent snapshot/result publication is rejected.
atomic_boundaries.result_effect: Reject the owning gap collection and result publication.

atomic_boundaries.scope: one semantic taxonomy tuple and tuple set
atomic_boundaries.reject_when: Code/applicability is inconsistent, subject type/suffix is outside the closed registry, a filler/provider-topology tuple appears, or a semantic tuple identity is duplicated.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: Valid record/provider observations remain, but invalid taxonomy publication is rejected rather than silently deduplicated.

atomic_boundaries.reject_when: Any final fact_id is duplicated or a constructor emits an unlisted fact/value vocabulary.
value_type and JSON kind differ, integer is not exact Int64, number is nonfinite, or the value is an object/array.
atomic_boundaries.retained_lower_layers: No coercion or repair is permitted.
